description: This file defines the UserController class in an ASP.NET Core application, handling user-related API endpoints such as retrieving current user details and updating user information.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Controller responsible for user API actions, utilizing dependency injection for mediator and user accessor services.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of the current authenticated user by username.

methods.name: UpdateUser
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update user details based on provided command data.
